name: Contract Version Diff
source_contract: MSA (A2 source) Version A + a second real MSA Version B
provenance: Real clauses, neutral labels (Version A/B). Authored gold directions (provisional).

criteria.criterion: No invented differences; both versions quoted/characterized accurately
Data return absent vs 15 business days (mandatory)
Auto-renewal nuance (A's short notice eases avoidance) — partial credit
Every difference assessed as unfavorable to Customer in Version A except the renewal nuance (mixed); the 2-day notice assessed as SEVERELY unfavorable
Clear favorable/unfavorable verdict per difference + overall Customer-perspective assessment

trips_on: Inventing a provision present in neither version
does_not_trip_on: A true characterization supported by the printed text

rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — A3 (Contract Version Diff) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Two real termination clauses printed as Version A / Version B; grade against the versions as printed. Directionality NOT scored (comparison, not advocacy); direction-for-Customer lives under Soundness.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] No invented differences; both versions quoted/characterized accurately. TRIPS ONLY ON: Inventing a provision present in neither version; Misquoting either version's terms. DOES NOT TRIP ON: A true characterization supported by the printed text.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, A3.diff.notice_period] Notice period 2 days vs 30/90 (mandatory); [critical, A3.diff.data_return] Data return absent vs 15 business days (mandatory); [minor, A3.diff.cause_requirement] Cause requirement absent vs present; [minor, A3.diff.cure_period] Cure period absent vs 30 days; [minor, A3.diff.survival] Survival clause absent vs present; [minor, A3.diff.renewal_nuance] Auto-renewal nuance (A's short notice eases avoidance) — partial credit.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Every difference assessed as unfavorable to Customer in Version A except the renewal nuance (mixed); the 2-day notice assessed as SEVERELY unfavorable.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Clear favorable/unfavorable verdict per difference + overall Customer-perspective assessment.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
